summary.text: Sally Cluchey is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 52 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lives in Bowdoinham, Maine, and has worked in organizational development and research.

paragraphs.text: Sally Cluchey lives in Bowdoinham, Maine.
She earned a B.A. in classics and classical languages, literatures, and linguistics from Kenyon College in 2001 and an M.S. in biomedical science and regulatory compliance from Hood College in 2008.

Her career experience includes founding AskEveryone, serving as director of organizational development of MPX and RxAnte, Inc., working as a senior research associate with The Brookings Institution, and working as an organizational consultant.
Cluchey has served as chairperson of the Bowdoinham Food Pantry and on the supervisory committee of the Infinity Federal Credit Union.
In the Maine House she was assigned to the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee and the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee in 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
